name: UPS-silos
title: U.P.S. Silo (Unified Production Supply Silo)
author: eggplantsalad
description: A wide/tall buffer chest for train-loading megabases with many stations. Unlike merged/warehouse chests, which add more slots as they grow, this keeps a fixed, small slot count and multiplies per-slot stack size instead - it stays UPS-efficient no matter how wide it gets, and reads out over a single circuit wire. See README for credits and details.
